ns2:course.label: Research Experience in Advertising
ns2:course.description: Supervised participation in research and scholarly activities, usually as an assistant to an investigator. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 9 hours. Prerequisite: ADV 150, ADV 281, or written consent of instructor.
